scope: Preparation for source-bound NTFS directory acquisition; no new work-unit implementation or admission
actual_dependencies: Bootstrap currently exposes JSON observations; its owned Observer retains the MFT mapping internally. Reuse the checked reader and ownership before any directory source offset is calculated.

The current collector parses base/extension FILE metadata with its existing non-directory flags policy. Named directory stream joining must define the exact applicable base/extension flag checks before widening either collector or joiner.
join_records currently selects an unnamed type. Directory $I30 root/allocation/bitmap require explicit exact original UTF16LE attribute-name selection; do not reinterpret another named stream.
Existing initialized MFT bounds only require record3. Record5 must be independently inside initialized/data coverage, with checked ordinal*record_bytes and complete validated mapping coverage.

INDEX_ROOT and INDX framing now have private decoders. A child VBN still needs the derived unit, block alignment, checked multiplication, stream initialized/data bounds and exact expected VBN before source reads.
Index bitmap bits address logical index blocks; they do not independently qualify global cluster allocation, MFT membership, collation, uniqueness or current-source consistency.

Every acquired root/extension/index/bitmap region must preserve original bytes/hashes, source-window/epoch context and finite read/retention/output limits, participate in overlap checks and final exact rereads.

Root-only supplied framing is not a complete namespace. Full references, FILE_NAME parent links, arbitrary directory depth, cycles, changed records, hard links, Upcase/collation, sparse/compressed/encrypted data, extraction and all other original filesystems/platforms remain required gates.
next_action: After DE-W088 terminal qualification and implementing-agent review, settle the source-bound directory execution contract and exact record/stream flags using primary format/implementation references. Preserve default bootstrap bytes and old refusal semantics; do not add an opener or authorize physical access.

flag_research: Pinned ntfs3g mft.c allocation starts from a cleared header and sets IN_USE; extent allocation binds the full base reference. This supports defining separate directory-base and extension flag checks, rather than propagating the directory bit to every FILE. This is a design inference for the next profile, not a claim that every on-disk variant is already admitted.
